subject: integration
name: Widgets standard (WIDGETS_0_1)
summary: A definition of WIDGETS_0_1: groups list (risk 3) and place (risk 4) with list, place, move and remove, which let a page see the widgets the person added and show them inside itself, at most eight at once, never over the browser's controls. The definition says the browser answers every function itself, and that a widget runs as its own site, cannot navigate or open windows and is handed nothing of the page. The list shows what the person uses. Nothing here checks a widget's own behaviour. The row has no code or request. Level 4 with privacy as a definition. Judged here by its publisher.
